aiUpdate.addressesHint: Other addresses of the same remote Magpie. Tried in order when the current address cannot connect; up to 8.
aiUpdate.agentAccountsHint: Keep a caller on one account or key. Automatic uses the provider's existing selection policy.
aiUpdate.balanceAuthHint: For keys belonging to different accounts at the same service, enter this account's access token and user ID.
aiUpdate.hideText: Do not retain recent request text
aiUpdate.hideTextHint: Recent calls keep status and usage only. Explicitly enabled request recording is managed separately.
aiUpdate.timeZoneHint: For example Asia/Shanghai or UTC. Empty follows the system; affects daily budget reset times.
aiUpdate.resetDaysHint: Limit the remaining lifetime of Codex resets used automatically. A maximum of 0 is unlimited; manual use is unchanged.
aiUpdate.waysOutHint: Region codes, IPs or CIDR ranges, one per line. Empty uses the upstream supported-region policy.
aiUpdate.autoReset: Allow this account's Codex resets to be used automatically
aiUpdate.autoResetHint: Use when this request encounters an exhausted weekly allowance and no other account is available; follows the remaining-days range.
